title: Digital practice labs for community arts groups
development_need: Fictional small community arts groups in Finland and Sweden have limited time and confidence to adopt useful digital practices.
target_groups: Staff and volunteers at fictional community arts groups in Finland and Sweden
expected_change: Participants use at least one suitable digital practice in their organization.
geography: Fictional communities in western Finland and eastern Sweden
funding_context: Possible cross-border cooperation; no funding programme has been selected.
